sentences.text: No; the home loan KFS shows a one-time processing fee of ₹400, not ₹4,000.
The home loan agreement also lists the processing fee as ₹400 once, at sanction.
The older KFS circular that required KFS disclosures is no longer in force on 2026-11-23, so the current in-force home loan KFS and agreement disclosures are the relevant documents here.
